name: Kaikku
source:
Wordsmith is an old man in Labyrinthia who seems to think himself something of a philosopher. He was a witness in both of Espella Cantabella's witch trials.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Wordsmith]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
